title: Quietly Tender Slovakian Beef Stew
description: A hearty one-pot Slovakian dish featuring tender beef and rich umami flavors, made with Marmite for added depth and using low-fat friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the Marmite, beef broth, tomato paste, thyme, black pepper, and salt to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 2.5 hours.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot and continue to simmer, covered, for an additional 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
